deployments_detail.use: ~100 identified AI use cases ("becoming an AI house"); AI/ML for autonomous convoy (won ELROB 2024), shortening decision cycles, reducing personnel needs

Battlesuite, a networked combat digital platform built on blackned's Tactical Core middleware, acts as the central hub for battlefield data flow and decision-making, supported by state-of-the-art AI to accelerate the sensor-to-shooter chain and integrate new AI-enabled capabilities as modular 'apps'. Demonstrated at NATO REPMUS / Dynamic Messenger 2025 exercises; Tactical Core is the operating system for the German Bundeswehr D-LBO (Digitalization of Land-Based Operations) program (EUR 1.2bn integration contract). [blackned (Rheinmetall subsidiary) Tactical Core / RIDUX middleware]

Strategic partnership with defence-AI firm Helsing to develop next-generation software-defined, AI-enabled land combat systems, combining Rheinmetall's platforms with Helsing's military-grade AI for target identification and battlefield decision support. [Helsing (defence AI software)]

Partnership with Auterion to develop a standardized AI-based drone operating system (AuterionOS, incl. AI-powered swarm capability Nemyx) for military unmanned systems, enabling interoperability across 200+ drone types. Auterion already supplies software for some Rheinmetall drones; Rheinmetall took a direct stake in Auterion in Nov 2025. [Auterion (AuterionOS / Nemyx)]

Strategic partnership with Anduril to co-develop and manufacture software-defined autonomous air systems for Europe (Barracuda cruise missiles, Fury autonomous fighter/CCA) plus solid rocket motors, using Anduril's autonomy/AI software stack, with Rheinmetall providing European production capacity. [Anduril (Barracuda, Fury autonomous air systems)]

Mission Master family of uncrewed ground vehicles (developed by Rheinmetall Canada) using an AI-enabled autonomy kit (PATH) that provides perception, navigation and decision-making across GPS-degraded and complex terrain. Delivered to the US Marine Corps (2024) and used in trials/training. [Rheinmetall Canada PATH autonomy kit]

Rheinmetall UK is a member of the Raytheon UK-led 'Omnia Training' consortium awarded a GBP 2bn / 15-year UK MoD contract to deliver an AI-based Combat Laboratory: a digital platform using AI, advanced analytics and virtual environments to train up to 60,000 British soldiers a year and support command decision-making. [Omnia Training consortium (Raytheon UK lead; Rheinmetall UK, Capita, Cervus, Skyral)]

Use of Spleenlab's VISIONAIRY AI-based perception software (autonomous navigation, GPS-denied localization, multi-object detection) for Rheinmetall's unmanned/drone and sensor systems, per Spleenlab's Rheinmetall customer story. [Spleenlab (VISIONAIRY AI perception)]

Joint development of a layered Counter-small-UAS (C-sUAS) air defense system integrating Rheinmetall's Skymaster command-and-control system and high-power guns with Anduril's Lattice AI software, Sentry Towers, Wisp sensors and Anvil interceptors to autonomously detect, identify and defeat drones. [Anduril (Lattice AI)]

AI-powered 3D digital twin (built with SPREAD.ai) for the Oerlikon Skyranger 30 air-defence system at Rheinmetall Air Defence, integrating PLM/PDM/CAD data via smart connectors to enable predictive and preventive maintenance, spare-parts management and mission readiness. [SPREAD.ai (knowledge-based-engineering digital twin)]
